In the upcoming college football game, scheduled for October 15 at 7:30 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Georgia Southern" if Georgia Southern win the game by 17 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Old Dominion".

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
